content.title: SuperCom: Q2 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: TEL AVIV, Israel (AP) — SuperCom Ltd. (SPCB) on Thursday reported profit of $1.1 million in its second quarter. On a per-share basis, the Tel Aviv, Israel-based company said it had profit of 25 cents. Earnings, adjusted for non-recurring costs and amortization costs, came to 49 cents per share.
